title: Decide per form whether the shared MAP9 fact reader widens or the repo rewords
why: q_max #1030 hit five forms the shared MAP9 fact line cannot express: an inline HTTP status, a constant written as arithmetic, an inline threshold, a date, and a cite that can only point at JSON. Detail in q_max #1030's PR body.
note: Nov 5 09:28 CST (coordinator): decide per form, widen the fact reader or reword. Only a form that two or more repos hit is worth a reader change; else the repo rewords (a repo changes to fit a shared tool).
